**nano.md 0.6.2 — Ctrl+T and math rendering**

- **Terminal:** press `Ctrl+T` on Windows/Linux or `Cmd+T` on macOS to show
  or hide the terminal. This replaces the backtick shortcut, which can be
  difficult to enter on some keyboard layouts. The toolbar button still
  works. (#36)
- **Math:** LaTeX in `$...$` and `$$...$$` renders in the preview and in
  print/PDF output. Rendering uses a bundled math font, with no network or
  TeX installation required. Unsupported expressions remain readable as
  source. (#29)
- **Contributing:** the README now links a short roadmap and scoped starter
  tasks, with a first-use walkthrough and clearer contribution guidance.
  (#34)

**Install:** download the archive for your platform below;
`SHA256SUMS.txt` covers all four archives. Windows and macOS binaries are
unsigned; the [install instructions](https://github.com/odysseia06/nanomd/blob/v0.6.2/README.md#install)
explain the first-launch prompts.

**Platforms:** Windows x86_64, macOS arm64 and x86_64 (`.app` bundles),
Linux x86_64 (glibc 2.35+, built on Ubuntu 22.04).

**Validation:** Ctrl+T was checked manually on Windows in the release-candidate
code. CI tests run on Windows, macOS and Linux; release packaging checks
the executable version and bundled licenses. Full macOS/Linux desktop
checks remain open contributor tasks.

Full changelog in [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/odysseia06/nanomd/blob/v0.6.2/CHANGELOG.md).
